# Error Handling Checklist: GitHub Pilot Issue Ingest and Eligibility

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009C1 requirements and plan artifacts fully define deterministic, operator-safe error behavior for live candidate absence, synthetic fallback failures, missing GitHub credentials, malformed GitHub data, sync failures, and no-side-effect preservation.
**Created**: 2026-05-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are no-safe-live-candidate requirements complete enough to require the operator path to use the explicit synthetic fallback rather than admitting an unsafe or ambiguous live issue? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1 Scenario 2, Spec §FR-011, Quickstart §Manual Live Smoke Path]
- [ ] CHK002 Are synthetic fallback reuse-before-create requirements complete for finding an existing open `[mc-pilot] synthetic e2e issue` before live creation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §Synthetic Fallback Issue, Contract §Synthetic Fallback Smoke Path]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define what happens when the synthetic fallback issue already exists but lacks `mc:inbox`, `priority:medium`, or `area:dev`? [Resolved: Spec §FR-019, Data Model §Synthetic Fallback Issue]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec define the failure outcome when synthetic fallback creation is requested with explicit live-mutation opt-in but GitHub creation fails? [Resolved: Spec §FR-020, Contract §Synthetic Fallback Smoke Path]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec define missing GitHub API credential behavior for the manual smoke/script path, including a non-mutating failure and actionable operator message? [Resolved: Spec §FR-020, Spec §SC-007, Quickstart §Manual Live Smoke Path]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the spec define GitHub sync failure handling for operator-triggered sync so a failed sync cannot be mistaken for a rejected ineligible candidate or successful no-op? [Resolved: Spec §FR-021, Contract §Operator-Triggered Sync Boundary]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the spec define handling for malformed or partial GitHub issue data before eligibility evaluation, including missing repository, issue number, state, labels, PR-link, or title fields? [Resolved: Spec §FR-022, Contract §Eligibility Decision Contract]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is the fallback boundary clear that no-safe-live-candidate is not an eligibility rejection reason for a specific issue, but an operator flow decision to use a live-mutation-gated fallback issue? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1 Scenario 2, Research §Synthetic Fallback]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "explicit live-mutation opt-in" specific enough to prevent accidental GitHub issue creation from normal app runtime, tests, or default smoke-script execution? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Session 1, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the distinction between credential-free automated tests and credential-required manual live smoke actions clear across spec, plan, and quickstart? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Plan §Constraints, Quickstart §Automated Fixture Coverage]
- [ ] CHK011 Are operator-visible error states phrased as structured evidence or checklist output instead of a new production eligibility UI/API surface? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-018, Plan §Structure Decision]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do fallback failure requirements align with the non-goals of no auto-close, no auto-delete, no automatic GitHub sync polling, and no production evidence API? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK013 Do missing-credential and live-mutation rules consistently keep CI fixture-only and prevent tests from requiring `GITHUB_TOKEN` or live GitHub mutation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Research §Synthetic Fallback]
- [ ] CHK014 Do sync-failure requirements preserve the invariant that a pilot task can only be counted after exactly one GitHub-linked root task with `github_synced_at IS NOT NULL` exists? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Do malformed-data requirements align with existing eligibility rejection reason semantics without silently accepting incomplete GitHub issue payloads? [Consistency, Contract §Eligibility Decision Contract]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can no-safe-live-candidate fallback behavior be objectively measured by evidence showing either a safe live issue was selected or the synthetic fallback path was used? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 1 Scenario 2, Quickstart §Manual Live Smoke Path]
- [ ] CHK017 Can synthetic fallback label failure or create failure be objectively measured without auto-repairing, auto-closing, or deleting the GitHub issue? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK018 Can missing GitHub credentials be objectively measured as a pre-mutation failure in the manual smoke/script path without requiring credentials in CI? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-012, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK019 Can GitHub sync failures and malformed or partial issue payloads be measured as distinct failure states from ineligible candidates, duplicate synced tasks, and successful idempotent no-ops? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario And Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are primary, exception, and recovery scenarios covered for safe live candidate found, no safe live candidate, fallback issue reused, fallback creation denied by missing opt-in, fallback creation failure, and fallback label mismatch? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1 Scenario 2, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are error scenarios covered for absent credentials, GitHub API failure, rate/permission failure, malformed issue payload, partial issue payload, and operator-triggered sync failure? [Resolved: Spec §SC-007, Quickstart §Fixture Expectations]
- [ ] CHK022 Are side-effect absence requirements preserved for every failure path so failed fallback or sync attempts do not create local-only pilot tasks, dispatch attempts, successor tasks, runs, artifacts, or remediation activities? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015]

## Dependencies And Assumptions

- [ ] CHK023 Are external dependency assumptions documented for live GitHub availability, credential permissions, required labels existing in the repository, and operator access to trigger the existing sync seam? [Resolved: Spec §Assumptions]
